_template: The Watch. Copy to seat/heimdallr/.mcp.json and replace @HOME@ and @VAULT_BOX@. That file is NOT tracked — **/.mcp.json is globally ignored on an operator box because it carries absolute paths and a seat identity.
_why_here: This repo is Willow's Grove: the root is the Desk and seats you as willow. The Watch is a lens you deliberately open — served-page honesty, the resident watcher, Gjallarhorn / #alerts, serve-mode auth. Opening Claude Code with this directory as the working directory makes it the project root, so this config is what loads and session_enter seats you as heimdallr. WILLOW_PROJECT_ROOT points at the grove root so the Watch reads the whole repository while the seat is chosen by where you opened it.
